† Abraham made haſt into the tent to Sara, and ſaid to her : ciuit.
Make haſt, temper togeather three meaſures of floure, and
make harth cakes. † But him ſelfe ranne to the heard, and
tooke from thence a calfe verie tender and verie good, and
gaue it to a young man : who made haſt and boiled it. † He
tooke alſo butter and mylke, and the calfe which he had
boyled, and ſet before them : but him ſelfe did ſtand befide
them vnder the tree. † And when thcy had eater, thcy
ſaid to him: Where is Sara thy wife ? He anſwered : Loe fhe is

thee at this time, life accompaning, and Sara thy wife ſhal
haue a ſonne. Which when Sara heard, ſhe laug hed behind
the dore of the tent. † And they were both aged, and farre
entred. in yeares, and it ceaſed to be with Sara after the
maner of wemen. † Who laughed ſecreatly ſaying: After
I am waxen old, & my Lord is an old one, ſhal I geue my ſelfe
to pleaſure? † And our Lord ſaid to Abraham : Why did Sara
laugh, ſaying : Shal I an old woman beare a child in deed?
